definition_quote.value: Polysomnographic technology means the allied health specialty practiced under the direction and supervision of a physician involving the attended monitoring and testing of individuals suffering from any sleep disorders as classified in the International Classification of Sleep Disorders.

advisory_committee_required.quote: The Advisory Committee on Polysomnography is hereby created and shall be composed of nine members to assist the Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners in the administration of the provisions of this Chapter.

advisory_committee_composition.value: Nine members: four licensed polysomnographic technologists registered by BRPT (selected by governor from list by Louisiana Academy of Sleep Medicine); one individual active in sleep medicine but not a licensed technologist (selected by governor from list by Louisiana Academy of Sleep Medicine); three physicians licensed by LSBME, two of whom are diplomats of ABSM and one active in sleep medicine (selected by governor from list by Louisiana State Medical Society); one hospital administrator (selected by governor from list by Louisiana State Hospital Association).
advisory_committee_composition.quote: Four members of the committee shall be licensed polysomnographic technologists registered by the Board of Registered Polysomnographic Technologists and shall be selected by the governor from a list of eight names submitted by the Louisiana Academy of Sleep Medicine. (b) One member of the committee shall be an individual who is not a licensed polysomnographic technologist but who is active in the field of sleep medicine to be selected by the governor from a list of three names submitted by the Louisiana Academy of Sleep Medicine. (c) Three members of the committee shall be physicians licensed by the Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners, two of whom shall also be diplomats of the American Board of Sleep Medicine, one of whom shall be active in the field of sleep medicine, and all of whom shall be selected by the governor from a list of eight names submitted by the Louisiana State Medical Society. (d) One member of the committee shall be a hospital administrator who shall be selected by the governor from a list of three names submitted by the Louisiana State Hospital Association.
